{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows low positivity (0.00) and true prices show persistent downward drift.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent high prices when sentiment includes 0.67 or higher, indicating bullish momentum.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction if forecast overshoots true price by >5% in consecutive days, especially after sharp spikes.",
    "Reduce forecast volatility when sentiment is neutral (0.00) and true prices exhibit low variance or consolidation.",
    "Correct for lagged overestimation by adjusting forecast downward by 10-15% for the first 3 days after a price spike.",
    "When sentiment history includes 0.33, anticipate a moderate correction and adjust forecast downward by 2-5% from peak.",
    "Avoid overreacting to single-day sentiment spikes; use 3-day rolling average sentiment to smooth corrections."
  ]
}
